store.title: One Line Fill
store.short: Draw one continuous line that fills every cell of the board.
store.long: A minimalist one-stroke puzzle. Start from the dot and draw a single line through every cell without crossing your own path. Boards grow from tiny shapes to twisting mazes with holes. Stuck? Use a hint to see the next steps. Every level has a solution.
store.how_to_play: Press on the dot and drag through neighbouring cells. Every cell must be visited exactly once. Drag back along the line to undo.
store.controls: Mouse or touch: press and drag.
